name: dogear
description: Search Dogear, post links with a one-line reason, and save things to your dogear with tags.
long_description: Dogear is a ranked catalog of recommended links. This extension lets Claude search the catalog, add links you ask it to add, and save items to your archive (your dogear) with tags and your own notes. It calls the Dogear REST API with an afk_ token that needs only the read and post scopes.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search the Dogear catalog. Call before add_item.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get one item with its source lists.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the category tree with slugs.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Post a link the user asked to add, with a one-line reason.

tools.name: save_item
tools.description: Save an existing item to the user's dogear with their note.

tools.name: add_to_list
tools.description: Tag an existing item in the user's dogear.

api_token.title: Dogear API token
api_token.description: An afk_ token from https://dogear.fyi/settings/tokens with the read and post scopes.

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Dogear site to talk to. Leave as https://dogear.fyi unless you run your own.
